excluded_escapes: reverse-engineering an unrelated graph separately for each scalar polynomial
multi-edge site gadgets followed by undeclared coefficient extraction or cancellation
calling a block-correlated gadget an ordinary independent edge-subset specialization

claim_boundary: The no-go is for natural product-local specializations with one independent named-polynomial ground element per site, not for arbitrary graph encodings of an already-known scalar polynomial.
Krushkal genus variables provide the correct torus readout but its edge-subset state family does not provide the required site J4 state.
The exact positive object is a new site/partition-surface rank-image quotient; no universal width-independent deletion-contraction algorithm is claimed.
